meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 在容器里装好 mnemon,并在每次容器启动时注册 Claude Code 钩子:Claude 回复前会自动带出相关旧记忆,每轮对话后把新要点写进记忆。记忆存在该 agent 组的 .claude/ 挂载里,容器重启后仍在。
howto.when: 仅在该 agent 组使用默认 Claude provider 时生效,容器一启动就自动注册钩子;若该组指定了别的 provider(如 opencode),钩子不会运行。

say.text: 还记得我们上次讨论的那个方案吗?
say.note: 它会自动带出相关旧记忆,不用你复述

say.text: 把这次结论记下来,下次接着聊
say.note: 每轮结束后写入记忆,存进 .claude/ 挂载

say.text: 能查一下我们之前定的那组配置参数吗?
say.note: 从过往记忆里检索并给出上下文

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon in the agent container and registers Claude Code hooks on each start: Claude recalls relevant past context before replying and saves new insights after every turn. Memory persists in the per-agent-group .claude/ mount.
howto.when_en: Only works for agent groups running the default Claude provider; hooks register on container start. If a group sets another provider, e.g. opencode, the hooks do not run.

say_en.text: Do you remember the plan we discussed last time?
say_en.note: It surfaces the relevant past memory for you

say_en.text: Save these conclusions so we can continue next time
say_en.note: Insights are written to memory after each turn

say_en.text: Can you look up the config values we set earlier?
say_en.note: It retrieves them from stored memory
